role.title: Backend Engineer
role.summary: Northwind Freight (an invented company) builds real time routing for regional delivery fleets. The backend team owns Python and Go services on Postgres and Kafka. The role designs and runs services that plan thousands of routes a day, and works closely with product on new planning features. It needs solid distributed systems judgement and clear ownership of production services.

candidate.name: Sam
candidate.summary: Sam Rivera (an invented candidate) has six years of backend work at a logistics company, mostly in Python and Go. Sam led a team of four on a routing service that cut delivery planning time from two hours to about ten minutes. Sam uses Kubernetes, Postgres and Kafka daily and wrote Terraform for most of the staging setup. Sam mentors two junior developers. Frontend work is the area Sam has done least.

questions.text: Tell me about yourself and what you have been working on recently.
probe_for: current focus that fits the role

questions.text: Tell me about a project you are proud of and your own part in it.
How would you design a service that has to plan thousands of delivery routes a day?
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a colleague on a technical decision.
This role touches some frontend work. How would you get up to speed there?
